sections.heading: Everyday clothing, made for here
paragraphs: ARBI started with a simple frustration: most of what we wanted to wear wasn't made for a city where the thermometer rarely drops below thirty. So we set out to make clothes that breathe — pure linen, combed cotton and fluid viscose — in shapes that feel modern without trying too hard.
Every piece is designed in Dhaka and made in partnership with workshops we visit regularly. We keep our range small on purpose, so each style earns its place.

sections.heading: What we care about
paragraphs: Three things guide every decision we make:
list: Honest fabrics — natural fibres first, chosen for comfort in the heat.
Fit you can trust — consistent sizing and detailed size charts on every product.
Service that feels personal — real people on WhatsApp, phone and email.

sections.heading: Visit us
paragraphs: Find us online every day, or visit one of our stores to try the collection in person. Our team is always happy to help you find your size.

sections.heading: Information we collect
paragraphs: When you place an order or create an account we collect your name, phone number, email address and delivery address. We also collect basic usage data such as pages visited, to improve the store.

sections.heading: How we use it
paragraphs: We use your information to process and deliver orders, provide customer support, and — only if you opt in — send you news about ARBI.

sections.heading: Sharing
paragraphs: We share delivery details with our courier partners and payment details with our payment gateway, only as needed to complete your order. We never sell your personal data.

sections.heading: Your choices
paragraphs: You can ask us to access, correct or delete your personal data at any time by contacting customer support.

paragraphs: If an item is faulty or not as described, we will refund the full amount to your original payment method, or as store credit for cash-on-delivery orders.
